mappings.note: The translation verse contains only the superscription (title/heading) 'Au maître-chantre. Psaume des enfants de Coré.' The OSMAIN text begins directly with the first line of the poem ('Til korlederen...'), effectively omitting a separate title verse.
Translation v2 corresponds to OSMAIN v1. Both contain the call to clap hands and shout to God.
Translation v3 corresponds to OSMAIN v2 regarding the Lord being the Most High and great King.
Translation v4 corresponds to OSMAIN v3 regarding subduing peoples under us.
Translation v5 corresponds to OSMAIN v4 regarding choosing the inheritance of Jacob. Both include 'Sela/Sélah'.
Translation v6 corresponds to OSMAIN v5 regarding God ascending with shouts and trumpets.
Translation v7 corresponds to OSMAIN v6 regarding singing praises to the King.
Translation v8 corresponds to OSMAIN v7 regarding God being king of all the earth.
Translation v9 corresponds to OSMAIN v8 regarding God reigning over nations and sitting on a holy throne.
Translation v10 corresponds to OSMAIN v9. Both describe the princes gathering as Abraham's people and God holding the shields of the earth.
